start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my course first-principles." It runs tool:read-a-course and shows its lessons in order with the ones I have done marked.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the courses, lessons and done tables of the pursuit database you name and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-a-course and the input.
3. Read the answer: the course, its lessons and how many are done. Show it with the screen the tool names.
